name: UWA Guild Food Pantry
summary: Free non-perishable food and hygiene items for enrolled UWA students, weekday mornings at the Guild Student Centre.
key: FREE non-perishable essential food items (like rice, pasta, UHT milk, cereal, soup, chickpeas and tuna)
who: The Guild Food Pantry is available only to UWA students that are enrolled in a current unit.
how: Bring your student ID and check in at reception, Monday to Friday 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM
catches: Up to three items per week, one of each item
